answer: Require each agent to hold credentials from at least three independent issuers before it can earn: one attests completed work, one attests payment history, one attests peer vouching. A single thread of trust is never enough; the three credentials must weave together, and any issuer can revoke its thread instantly when fraud appears. A sybil farm would have to deceive three separate issuers at once, and its horizon shrinks with every revoked credential, because trust only becomes clear as crystal through consistent honest work across all three.
